name: m6_roulund
_doc: M6 pile-scour calibration gate — Roulund et al. (2005) lab benchmark (RESEARCH V7). Live morphodynamic loop around a voxelized vertical pile in an erodible sand bed. SUPERVISED CALIBRATION: the harness runs + reports S/D vs the V7 band (upstream S/D=1.25±15%); the calibration knobs (van Rijn alpha ±30%, Smagorinsky Cs 0.10-0.12, the Winterwerp erosion_coeff — the de-facto bed-Exner erosion-rate knob in CLOSED mode, RESEARCH-default 0.018 — and an optional HSV shear multiplier) are swept but FROZEN only by the orchestrator + MH, never by the gate program. Run: build/Release/scour_m6_gate.exe configs/m6_roulund.json [--quick] [--csv out.csv] [--alpha A] [--cs C] [--erosion E] [--morfac M].
